identification: 5 framed works: (1-2) TWO Bea Maddock 'Red Text' sheets, plates XXV and XXVI, from her 40-part 'Red Text' (Genesis) series: hand-scripted text printed from etched zinc plates in hand-ground red ink on handmade NZ flax paper coated with wax, printed at Ritchies Mill studio, Launceston, 1984 (typed artist's statement on the back of one frame confirms this), in matching timber frames; (3) pen-and-ink drawing of a man from behind with umbrella and bag, black frame; (4) small abstract print of dark cell-like shapes in a brick-pattern painted frame; (5) small pen and wash sketch of a city building/church, timber frame, signed lower right (illegible).
